channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Enceladus ice plumes prove stranger than expected
item.description: Enceladus may separate and concentrate chemicals from its hidden ocean as droplets freeze and shatter on their way into space.

item.title: Galápagos sea turtles stayed close to home
item.description: Yellow-morph green sea turtles in the Galápagos surprised scientists by remaining close to home rather than making long journeys.

item.title: Suitcase-sized spacecraft may detect universe before stars
item.description: CosmoCube will use the Moon's far side to block Earth's radio noise and search for a faint signal from the universe before the first stars.

item.title: NASA's Crew-13 may reach ISS in under 9 hours
item.description: NASA and SpaceX could launch four astronauts to the International Space Station on October 1, with the Dragon spacecraft reaching the orbiting outpost less than nine hours later.
